sections.title: Chief Complaint / Motif de consultation
sections.description: Primary presenting concern in the patient's own words, with anatomical site and laterality (right/left) and duration when stated. Include the patient's stated goal for the consultation when voiced. Record as spoken — never restate it as a diagnosis.

sections.title: History of Present Illness / Histoire de la maladie actuelle
sections.description: Onset, duration, mechanism (surgical, traumatic, pressure, vascular, congenital), and progression of the wound or concern; character of any pain; associated symptoms (drainage, odour, fever, increasing redness, dehiscence); prior wound care, dressings, or reconstruction tried and their result. Capture only as the patient or physician states it — one claim per distinct element.

sections.title: Past Medical History / Antécédents médicaux
sections.description: Relevant conditions affecting wound healing or perfusion as stated (e.g. diabetes, peripheral vascular disease, immunosuppression, prior radiation, smoking status, nutritional concerns). Capture only what is mentioned; leave not_captured if none discussed.

sections.title: Past Surgical History / Antécédents chirurgicaux
sections.description: Prior surgeries and relevant anaesthetic history as stated, with site, laterality, and approximate timing where given. Include previous reconstruction, flaps, grafts, or implants at the site when mentioned. Leave not_captured if none discussed.

sections.title: Medications / Médicaments
sections.description: Current medications with dose, route, and frequency exactly as stated (e.g. 'cefalexin 500 mg by mouth four times daily', 'apixaban 5 mg twice daily'); include anticoagulants, antibiotics, immunosuppressants, and relevant PRN analgesics. Leave not_captured if none discussed.

sections.title: Allergies / Allergies
sections.description: Stated drug or material allergies (including adhesives, latex, and topical agents) and the reaction when given. Leave not_captured if allergies are not addressed during the encounter.

sections.title: Wound / Site Assessment — Évaluation de la plaie
sections.description: Each finding as stated, leading with the structure: location and laterality; dimensions as length × width × depth in cm (with undermining or tunnelling depth and clock position when given); wound-bed tissue types with proportions; exudate amount and character; wound edges; periwound skin; flap or graft viability (colour, capillary refill in seconds, warmth, congestion or pallor); stated signs of infection. Describe only — never infer healing trajectory or aetiology. One claim per finding.

sections.title: Imaging Review / Revue de l'imagerie
sections.description: Imaging findings as literally described on screen — modality, laterality, and the specific view or sequence for each finding. One claim per view or finding, described only and never interpreted beyond the physician's own words. Leave not_captured if no imaging is reviewed.

sections.title: Assessment / Évaluation
sections.description: The physician's stated working assessment, one claim per problem and attributed to the physician. Include contributing factors and any differential the physician voiced. Record only conclusions actually spoken — never infer aetiology. Where grounded synthesis is enabled, every synthesized statement must cite the wound, exam, imaging, or history source(s) it rests on.

sections.title: Plan / Plan de traitement
sections.description: The plan as stated, one claim per item grouped by: investigations ordered; referrals; dressing and treatment options discussed with their trade-offs and cost when mentioned; reconstructive or surgical options offered, with risks, expected outcome, and recovery counselled; wound-care and activity advice; smoking or nutrition counselling when given; and follow-up interval.
